# Prerecorded speech fixture

`1_jackson_0.wav` is an unmodified recording of the spoken digit one, speaker Jackson, from Free Spoken Digit Dataset by Zohar Jackson, Jakobovski and contributors.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jakobovski/free-spoken-digit-dataset/26eb9aaf76e81b692f806f9140c2d2777410d7a1/recordings/1_jackson_0.wav
Upstream project: https://github.com/Jakobovski/free-spoken-digit-dataset
Pinned source commit: `26eb9aaf76e81b692f806f9140c2d2777410d7a1`
SHA-256: `b3739400f793620875bb7849bfd8629dc6b2966ed6bda8276aa14178a612f13a`
License for this audio fixture: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ . This license applies to the audio fixture, independently of the Rust source code. Preserve attribution and license when distributing adapted audio.

The original is 8 kHz mono PCM16. Tests explicitly interpolate it to 16 kHz; generated comparison WAVs are adaptations under the same CC BY-SA 4.0 license. This is real prerecorded speech, not TTS or a synthesized speech-like waveform. It is a short digit, not a conversational speech quality corpus.
